final_decision.minimal_fix: Compute t_end - t_start on every rank, reduce those double durations with MPI_Reduce using MPI_DOUBLE and MPI_MAX, and convert and print the reduced duration on rank 0.
final_decision.semantic_equivalence_basis: The root interval is not a proven global makespan. For the prescribed n=2000 and 128 ranks, each rank owns 31250 elements initialized locally. On every rank, runSimulation posts nonblocking receives and then packs owned energies before any wait or received-data dependency. Non-root halo packing can therefore precede rank 0's timestamp. Additionally, rank 127 has ghost-dependent elements only in its first 2000 owned positions, so updateRange(b_hi, n_local) can update its remaining 29250 elements before MPI_Waitall, using local data without a root dependency. The final barrier establishes completion but cannot recover useful work that started before the root timer.
final_decision.notes: The independent-work example uses the supplied full-benchmark configuration: -n 2000 -i 5000 with 128 MPI ranks. Millisecond conversion and display truncation are acceptable. No accelerator work is present.
